Data sent to providers

A prompt request sends the prompt you chose, selected model ID, and saved API key for authentication to that provider over HTTPS. Project files and chat history are not sent automatically. Testing the key requests the model list but sends no prompt.
Important key-protection limits

Keys are encrypted at rest with Android Keystore, but the app must read them to make requests, so a compromised app or device may expose them. Google recommends a server-side proxy for production client apps. Restrict directly used keys and their quotas.
